content.title: Disadvantage Recovery | Ground Escape, Guard, Counter, Radial Clear
content.summary: Place one original clearly adult protagonist at a measurable disadvantage inside a ring of adult opponents. The recovery must progress through four distinct but materially continuous ability states: a grounded positional escape, a compact guard that visibly deforms under one close hit, a focused counter that uses the retained material, and one floor-bound radial release that moves opponents outward. Preserve the same water, light, dust or other medium between stages and keep bodies readable through every effect. End on a quiet center-versus-ring tableau.

quick_start.input_format: Use clearly adult original characters in a non-school setting and establish a measurable center-versus-ring disadvantage. + Begin recovery with one grounded positional action before any large ability. + Make one compact guard visibly deform under a close committed hit while both bodies remain readable. + Reuse the same retained medium for the focused counter and radial release. + End with opponents displaced outward and the same adult calm at the unchanged center.
quick_start.recommended_input: Open in an original underground survey bay: one clearly adult rescue engineer stands inside a painted circle while four malfunctioning inspection drones close from mapped positions; no school styling and no effect yet. One drone commits a close clamp. The retained dust lifts into a compact translucent guard that dents at the contact point while the adult and drone remain visible. Dust settles into the painted ring. Hold the same adult calm at center while the four drones lie outside the circle; no copied school, uniforms, water effect, choreography or text.
